desc: Derive math: sum over subarrays of (subarray sum)^K equals sum over prefix-index pairs i<j of (P[j]-P[i])^K, with P[0..N] and P[0]=0.
Implement O(N*K) prefix-sum binomial aggregation in Python maintaining running power sums S_t = sum_{i<r} P[i]^t mod 998244353.
Precompute binomial coefficients C(K,t) mod p and handle negative signs via modular reduction.
Write final program that reads from stdin and writes only the answer to stdout within code delimiters.
